Compute school- or district-level enrollment counts and subgroup proportions

Source: R/01_trend_enrollment.R
compute_school_district_enrollment.Rd

Aggregates enrollment to the school or district level, computing total enrollment and year-over-year changes. Optionally computes subgroup proportions for each entity.

Usage

compute_school_district_enrollment(
  data,
  level = "school",
  assessment_spec,
  subgroup_vars = NULL,
  min_n = 10
)

Arguments

data

A long-format student results data frame (see data contract).

level

Character scalar: "school" or "district".

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

subgroup_vars

Character vector of demographic columns to compute proportions for. Defaults to names(assessment_spec$demographics).

min_n

Integer. Subgroup cells with N < min_n have pct_sg set to NA. Default 10.

Value

A named list:

  • $totals — data frame: entity ID/name columns, YEAR, N, N_change, N_pct_change

  • $by_subgroup — long-format data frame: entity columns, YEAR, subgroup_var, subgroup_val, N_sg, pct_sg, suppressed Returns an empty list if entity ID columns are not present in the data.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
# sgpData_LONG has no SCHOOL_ID — this returns an empty list for that dataset
compute_school_district_enrollment(demo_data, level = "school", assessment_spec)
} # }
